source_message.text: Please do this. Make it look as close as possible. I really like the look and functionality of the render. Also, one difference from the rendering. The plate on the back of the machine that reads "Karla's Matcha Mixer", place that on the front. The spout and the mixers would be in front of the baristas but the customer would see it from a different angle. I want "Karla's Matcha Mixer to face the customer.
